categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in photovoltaic (PV) components manufacturing, PV system products, large-scale energy storage system production and sales, and PV power station engineering construction. It has three main business segments: PV components, energy (including PV power stations), and energy storage systems. The PV components segment includes design, development, production, and sales of solar modules and systems. The energy storage segment focuses on large-scale and residential energy storage solutions, while the energy segment involves EPC services for PV power stations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced photovoltaic technologies including N-type TOPCon cells, Heterojunction (HJT) cells, large-size silicon wafers (182mm and 210mm), PERC cells, and innovative BIPV (Building Integrated Photovoltaics) systems. It integrates automated, intelligent, and digital manufacturing processes with MES systems for production management. The energy storage products utilize lithium iron phosphate (LFP) battery technology with advanced liquid cooling and battery management systems. The company also develops proprietary materials such as encapsulation films, welding ribbons, and junction boxes to enhance product performance and durability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a global customer base across more than 160 countries, including key markets in China, the Americas, Europe, Japan, Australia, and emerging markets like Africa and Latin America. Customers include utility-scale PV power plant developers, commercial and industrial users, residential users, and EPC contractors. The company also targets high-end residential markets with its HJT products and provides integrated energy storage solutions to grid operators and end-users.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production bases in China (multiple locations including Suzhou, Yangzhou, Suqian), Thailand, the United States (Texas), and Vietnam. It has established sales and service networks in over 160 countries, including major markets in China, the US, Europe, Japan, Australia, South America, and Africa. The company maintains a strong international presence with subsidiaries and sales offices in North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and emerging markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as a vertically integrated manufacturer within the photovoltaic supply chain, covering upstream silicon wafer production, midstream solar cell and module manufacturing, and downstream system integration and EPC services. It also extends into energy storage system manufacturing and integrated energy solutions, positioning itself across multiple points in the PV and energy storage value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding N-type TOPCon technology capacity, advancing HJT cell development, and innovating in BIPV systems. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on high-efficiency solar cells, large-size wafers, lightweight modules, and advanced energy storage technologies such as long-life lithium-ion batteries and liquid-cooled storage systems. It also emphasizes digitalization and automation in manufacturing and participates actively in international standards development to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of photovoltaic modules, PV system products, large-scale and residential energy storage systems, and EPC services for PV power stations. The company uses a direct sales model supplemented by distributors, with long-term supply contracts and project-based sales. It also earns revenue from value-added services such as system integration, maintenance, and energy trading related to storage systems.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading global player in the photovoltaic and energy storage industry, consistently ranked among the top five PV module suppliers worldwide for 13 consecutive years. It competes with other major PV manufacturers and energy storage integrators globally. Its competitive advantages include advanced technology, global production and sales footprint, strong brand recognition, and integrated energy solutions. The company is recognized as a technology leader and a top-tier supplier by industry analysts like BloombergNEF.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 51.31 billion, representing a 7.94% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 2.9 billion, up 34.61% from the previous year. The company’s total assets reached RMB 65.78 billion, growing 36.18% year-over-year, with net assets increasing by 83.64%. The company’s R&D investment increased by over 50%, reflecting a strong growth trajectory supported by expanding production capacity and international market penetration.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced, and cost-effective photovoltaic and energy storage products. Its value proposition includes leading-edge N-type TOPCon and HJT cell technologies, large-size wafer utilization for higher power output, and integrated BIPV solutions that combine aesthetics with functionality. The company also offers comprehensive energy storage solutions with superior safety, long life, and intelligent management features. Its global footprint and strong brand enable reliable supply and service, creating competitive barriers and customer loyalty.
